When parsing the line `6`, `md_is_container_mark` is called with `beg` pointing to `6`. The digit loop runs: `off` starts at `beg`, `ISDIGIT(off)` is true, so `off` becomes `beg+1`. Now `off == ctx->size` (end of buffer). The loop exits. Then `off > beg` is true, and `CH(off)` reads `ctx->text[ctx->size]` which is out of bounds.
